scope: Development ranking comparison, not accuracy or original-tool rerun
population: Frozen discovery-common-scope-01 code-eligible IDs, including missing documentation
code: Existing Rust SCC token multiset intersection divided by maximum length, all unordered eligible pairs
documentation: Unchanged doc-tfidf-discovery-v1 fitted on original 2180 bindings; candidates restricted to common eligible endpoints
fusion: Arithmetic mean of code and document cosine, zero documentation stays zero; no tuned weights or missing-doc fallback
ranking: Score rounded to 12 decimals descending, lexicographic canonical ID pair ties, positive scores only
checks: Input hashes against prior scope; code scores at 0.8 reproduce original SCC pair set; preserve all empty-doc coverage and cutoff ties
evaluation: Candidate differences only; no independent truth labels and no precision/recall claims
stop: One fixed three-method batch and candidate review queue; no score/weight/token-threshold tuning
